title: Death analytics
description: This project adds the mod death analytics
body:
Death Analytics is a client-side Minecraft mod that tracks and displays detailed information about player deaths. It records death locations, causes of death, and related statistics, then presents them in a structured interface to help players analyze patterns and improve survival strategies. The mod focuses on clear data presentation and lightweight performance, integrating seamlessly into the game without affecting core gameplay mechanics.
